_meta.description: Per-type_id tile-level skill extraction config for 'Навыки' sheet. Universal — works for any save of any map. Two types of objects produce rows in Навыки sheet: Witch Huts (1 skill per row, computed from tile bytes) and Universities (4 skills per row, joined as comma-separated string, read from post-tile Univer section).

113.notes: Witch Hut. Skill_id is computed from 2 bytes: top 4 bits of byte s+8 (low nibble) shifted left by 3, plus top 5 bits of byte s+7 (>>5). If skill_id < 28, look up TblSecondarySkill[skill_id]. Single skill per row.

104.notes: University (Университет / University of Magic). Tile scan creates an empty R_Skill row (no skill_id set). Post-tile UniverContent reads 4 skill_ids (one per 4-byte slot at offsets 0, 4, 8, 12 within the 16-byte record) and joins them as 'skill1, skill2, skill3, skill4'. The skill_id at each offset is a u8 lookup into TblSecondarySkill[].
